paragraphDevelopment.rule: Single-sentence substantial paragraphs are allowed only up to the count already present in the accepted reference for that section/locale, and must remain within the reference-derived minimum length band.

paragraphMinimum.rule: Candidate paragraph minimum is max(hard floor, 90% of the accepted reference section's shortest paragraph). Single-sentence paragraph floor is derived separately from the accepted reference's shortest single-sentence paragraph.
paragraphMinimum.purpose: Allow intentional short closing paragraphs present in the gold reference without permitting greater fragmentation in generated customer copy.
